facts.fact: EBS chief executive Saif El-Din Bari said the Central Bank of Sudan has entrusted EBS with the technical operation of the National Payment Switch, connecting bank and fintech switches under the Central Bank's supervision.

SDN.note: No consumer rules or complaints body stated.
SWIFT service bureau accreditation is not a cross-border digital payment corridor.
Switch linkage is said to keep payment data in Sudan, but no government strategy, rule, hosting site or contract terms on state data are stated.
Payments of government service fees only; no payments to people stated.
No account share stated; only a count of transfers.

facts.fact: EBS, the Central Bank of Sudan's operating arm for electronic payments, supports retail payment services, electronic purchases and bill payments, and has processed over 234 million account-to-account transfers between banks since resuming operations last year.
The article says EBS enables government service payments across Sudan, without naming the taxes or fees or giving figures.
